aboutGame.title: What is 8 Ball Duels?
paragraphs: 8 Ball Duels is a competitive online multiplayer billiards game on Roblox featuring realistic table physics, head-to-head 1v1 duels, and multi-round knockout tournament brackets. Players wager coins across distinct billiard halls, line up precise angles, and sink solids or stripes before potting the 8-ball for victory.

Master cue ball spin manipulation, fine-tune your aiming guidelines, and upgrade specialized cues to improve shot accuracy, power, and shot clock limits. Whether you are executing delicate bank shots or orchestrating multi-ball caroms, our wiki delivers comprehensive strategies and mechanical breakdowns to help you dominate every table.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about 8 Ball Duels rules, mechanics, cues, and codes.

items.question: What is 8 Ball Duels?
items.answer: 8 Ball Duels is a competitive online billiards game on Roblox where players compete in real-time 1v1 pool matches and tournament brackets following standard 8-ball rules.

items.question: How do match rules and fouls work in 8 Ball Duels?
items.answer: In 8 Ball Duels, the table remains open until a player legally sinks a called ball, deciding solids or stripes. Fouling by scratching or hitting opponent balls awards cue ball in hand, while sinking the 8-ball early causes an immediate loss.

items.question: How do I redeem promo codes in 8 Ball Duels?
items.answer: To redeem codes in 8 Ball Duels, open the in-game Shop or Settings menu from the lobby, tap the Promo Code button, enter your active voucher, and confirm to claim free coins and cue items.

items.question: Which cue stats should I prioritize upgrading in 8 Ball Duels?
items.answer: When upgrading cues in 8 Ball Duels, prioritize Aim guideline extension and Spin control for positioning. Extra Time is essential for complex cluster shots, while Power should be upgraded with care to prevent scratches.

items.question: How do tournament brackets work in 8 Ball Duels?
items.answer: Tournaments in 8 Ball Duels feature single-elimination knockout brackets for 8 to 32 players, where stringing together consecutive frame wins earns exclusive trophies and large coin rewards.
